data.title: Nobu Residences
data.about:
Explore Nobu Residences by H&H Developement. Located off the picturesque coast of Ras Al Khaimah, Nobu Residences Al Marjan Island stands at the heart of the Emirate's pioneering man-made archipelago, offering a unique blend of luxury and natural beauty.

The residential options here are diverse, encompassing 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, elegant garden duplexes, lavish penthouses, and exclusive private villas. All residents enjoy privileged access to the world-class amenities of the Nobu Hotel, enhancing their living experience with a touch of luxury. Additionally, residents benefit from an array of exclusive facilities tailored to their lifestyle. 

Situated on the tranquil shores of Al Marjan Island, Nobu Residences provides an unparalleled opportunity to immerse yourself in a distinct island lifestyle that epitomizes 'The Nobu Way'. Each moment at Nobu Residences is a meticulously crafted experience, juxtaposing the untouched serene beauty of Ras Al Khaimah with the vibrant entertainment and festive atmosphere unique to Al Marjan Island. This is where life achieves a perfect balance, offering a harmonious blend of peaceful retreat and exhilarating island festivities.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Life the Nobu Way
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Highly personalized, fully integrated residences embodying Nobu's unique lifestyle philosophy.
  • A blend of traditional Japanese minimalism and cool modern luxury.
  • Tranquil sunrises and unforgettable sunsets enhancing the serene living atmosphere.
  • Access to exquisite dining, unique events, and entertainment specific to the island.
  • Located on Al Marjan Island, set against the Arabian Peninsula and mountains' picturesque backdrop.
  • Ideal for exploring Ras Al Khaimah's diverse attractions, from beaches to mountains and culture to nature.
  • Offers a life in perfect balance, combining beachside serenity with cultural and natural experiences.

location_tile.title: Sun and Serenity at Al Marjan Island
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
In the heart of Ras Al Khaimah lies Al Marjan Island, a cluster of four coral-inspired islets extending majestically into the Gulf's sparkling azure waters. This impressive island, spread across 2.7 million square metres of land reclaimed from the sea and home to eight kilometres of immaculate white sandy beaches, serves as a tribute to the wonders of nature and the resourcefulness of human engineering.

  • 25 minutes to Ras Al Khaimah Airport
  • 35 minutes to Sharjah Airport
  • 45 minutes to Dubai Airport
  • 2 hours to Abu Dhabi Airport
